_readme: The game catalog. Edit this, then run: python tools/hub.py sync. See CLAUDE.md.

games.title: Block Escape
games.desc: Slide coloured blocks out through the gate of their colour before the clock runs out. 300 levels, a Daily board and a Zen mode.
games.desc_es: Desliza los bloques de colores hacia la puerta de su color antes de que se acabe el tiempo. 300 niveles, un tablero diario y un modo Zen.

content.notes: Cartoon microbes eat each other

games.title: Amazonia
games.desc: 3D throwing duels between jungle warrior women: javelins, axes and chakrams across lagoons, hills and islands. Pick the angle, watch your last arc, beat the wind. 8 Contracts, vs Computer, 2 players or online.
games.desc_es: Duelos de lanzamiento en 3D entre guerreras de la selva: jabalinas, hachas y chakrams sobre lagunas, colinas e islas. Elige el ángulo, mira tu último arco, vence al viento. 8 Contratos, contra la computadora, 2 jugadores o en línea.

content.notes: 3D turn-based throwing duel between stylised jungle women warriors in cloth tops and ragged war skirts (no nudity, no sexual content); hits flash and spark, the loser falls and lies still, no blood or gore

games.title: The Hunt
games.desc: Look out over a mountain valley through a rifle scope. Your aim sways with every breath: hold it, wait for the calm, and take a clean shot. Open Season, 24 Contracts and Practice.
games.desc_es: Mira un valle de montaña a través de la mira de un rifle. Tu puntería se balancea con cada respiración: aguanta el aire, espera la calma y haz un disparo limpio. Temporada abierta, 24 Contratos y Práctica.

content.notes: Hunting with a scoped rifle: deer, boar, foxes, hares fall when hit; no blood, no gore, no people. Owner to confirm the rating

games.title: Red Mist
games.desc: Combat sniper: 30 contracts in 6 places, by day and night, in fog, rain and storms. Take down the officer, beat the clock, stop the trucks. Wait for the breath, then squeeze.
games.desc_es: Francotirador de combate: 30 contratos en 6 lugares, de día y de noche, con niebla, lluvia y tormentas. Abate al oficial, gana al reloj, detén los camiones. Espera a la respiración y aprieta.

content.notes: Combat sniper game: rifle shots at soldiers seen from far away; a hit shows a brief red mist puff and the figure falls and fades; exploding drums and trucks; civilians must not be hit; no gore, no close-ups. Options can swap the red mist for dust. Owner to confirm the rating
